title: Implement Controllable
instructions:
Complete the `Motor` class so it implements the `Controllable` interface.

The `Motor` class should:
1. Implement the `Controllable` interface
2. Have a `var isRunning: Boolean` property that starts as `false`
3. `enable()` should set `isRunning` to `true`
4. `disable()` should set `isRunning` to `false`

The `Controllable` interface is already written for you. Do not change it.
hint: Use `: Controllable` after the class name. Then use `override fun enable()` and `override fun disable()` to implement both methods.
